short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: Two sources at once… so confusing!
short_scenes.narration: Volt's circuit has two batteries pushing at the same time.
Switch one source off, a voltage source becomes a short, and find its effect. Then do the other one. Then add.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: But never add powers. Only currents and voltages.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: Watch the full video: Superposition theorem!
short_scenes.narration: For the detailed explanation, watch the full video on our channel. It's part of our complete Network Theory course.
